desc:
Welcome to Would You Rather: Dance Tower! 👋

Climb the tower by choosing between the two doors every stage 🎭
Each choice gives you a new dance... sometimes it’s fire, sometimes it’s totally cursed 💀

Unlock different dances, goofy emotes, rare animations, funny walks, and crazy moves to build the ultimate combo 🕺✨
Or end up with the weirdest dance set ever 😂

Every run feels different with MILLIONS of dance combinations to discover 🎲

Make it to the top and see your final dance loadout
Then compare your style with your friends and see who got the best moves 😆

Like the game 👍 and join the Group for extra perks 🎉
